pairs: Beatus qui intelligit super egenum et pauperem:
Blessed is he who shows understanding toward the needy and the poor.
in die mala liberabit eum Dominus.
The Lord will deliver him in the evil day.
et beatum faciat eum in terra,
and make him blessed upon the earth.
et non tradat eum in animam inimicorum ejus.
And may he not hand him over to the will of his adversaries.
Dominus opem ferat illi super lectum doloris ejus;
May the Lord bring him help on his bed of sorrow.
universum stratum ejus versasti in infirmitate ejus.
In his infirmity, you have changed his entire covering.
because I have sinned against you.”
My enemies have spoken evils against me.
And when he came in to see me,
His heart gathered iniquity to itself.
and he was speaking in the same way.
In idipsum adversum me susurrabant omnes inimici mei;
All my enemies were whispering against me.
They were thinking up evils against me.
They established an unjust word against me.
Numquid qui dormit non adjiciet ut resurgat?
Will he that sleeps no longer rise again?
Etenim homo pacis meæ in quo speravi,
For even the man of my peace,
who ate my bread, has greatly supplanted me.
In hoc cognovi quoniam voluisti me,
By this, I knew that you preferred me:
quoniam non gaudebit inimicus meus super me.
because my adversary will not rejoice over me.
But you have sustained me, because of my innocence,
et confirmasti me in conspectu tuo in æternum.
and you have confirmed me in your sight in eternity.
Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël a sæculo
Blessed is the Lord God of Israel,
for all generations and even forever.
